name: Bréifne

attributes.attribute: a famed territory of Ireland bears her name
a warrior woman who died defending her land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bréifne is the name of a region of early Ireland. The district covers the counties of the north central part of the country. Old books and a learned journal carry the same name. The area kept a separate identity and a firm place in the old memory of the land. Its tales belong to the early people of the north. The name holds a long story that links the region to the wider island.

okr.objective: Describe Bréifne, the Irish figure behind a famous territory's name.
key_results: One of Ireland's most famous territories bears her name.
She may have been a goddess of sovereignty.
The Dindshenchas calls her a warrior woman.
She died defending her land from evil invaders.
